needs.what: nxnative gives this game a 3.25 GB heap region (nxweb: 1.50 GB); a game that sizes its heap from the memory pool it is told about will ask for more than a 4 GB WebAssembly memory can map (the pool nxweb reports would have to be smaller; not tried).

cuts.why: frame limiter target: mov w1,#30 → mov w1,#60 (main+0x707090 sleeps out 1000 / fps ms since the last frame)
frame update step: ldr s8,[x8,#0x6ec] (1/30) → ldr s8,[x8,#0x834] (1/60), passed to main+0x6a337c
